limitations: Independent agent walkthrough in headless Chromium by a different agent from the author and the source reviewer; not a human user study and not feature-owner approval.

The lab openlaw-docs-80ceef9e-work2 (work2) is shared with other DOC-030 walkthrough agents. This run created only records named "DOC-030 entities ..." (run tag 0925-1129), plus records from earlier development runs of the same script with other tags. API calls prepared fixtures or read back results the browser had already shown; every documented action ran through the browser controls.

Author limitation, checked on the lab: Reminder and daily-briefing delivery depend on the worker schedule and were not re-read in this pass beyond the unchanged sources; the guide makes no new claim about them.

3 page loads showed the app's "Something went wrong." screen with net::ERR_NETWORK_CHANGED while other labs changed the host's Docker networks; the script reloaded once and the step then passed. This is an environment effect, not an app finding.

Column widths: at 1280px the flexible Obligation column already sits at its 120px minimum, so a column cannot be made wider than its default; the walkthrough narrowed the Note column by drag and by ArrowLeft and checked that the width carried to another Entity's table. A drag that starts on the visible edge line does nothing because the next heading cell covers most of the resize strip; this is recorded as a product bug in the log.
Reminder and daily-briefing delivery were not exercised; they depend on the worker schedule. The article makes no claim beyond pointing to notification preferences.
The Home check used overdue due dates in 2014 and 2015 so that the fixtures sort first within Home's limited row set on a shared lab.
